review_scope: Every remaining Gauteng identity blocked because its generated natural key collides with another factual identity and no approved identity-specific grouping has been established.
decision_policy: A collision may be grouped only by an identity-specific researched artifact that establishes the same accepted context for every identity in the group.
Distinct municipal contexts are not merged because their generated city-scope key is the same province-level slug.
A source listing a similar name, parcel designator, or adjacent context is not treated as an identity match without a direct reconciliation.
This audit records retain-queue decisions only; it does not create runtime rows or alter canonical identities.

evidence_reviewed.publisher: Office of the Chief Justice, Department of Justice and Constitutional Development
evidence_reviewed.finding: The official Gauteng area index lists Slovoville under the West Rand / Kagiso Sub District, while the canonical identity is in a City of Johannesburg context.

entries.rationale: The canonical identity and the official area index disagree on the municipal context. The identity cannot be grouped under Johannesburg or reassigned to West Rand without an identity-level boundary reconciliation.
entries.next_action: Reconcile the canonical point against an official municipal or boundary source, then record a corrected context, parent edge, or retirement disposition.

evidence_reviewed.finding: The official Gauteng area index contains multiple Elandsfontein entries with parcel-designated contexts, including Johannesburg and Tshwane; it does not identify these two canonical records directly.

entries.rationale: The canonical Elandsfontein identities span City of Tshwane and City of Johannesburg. The official index confirms multiple same-name jurisdictional possibilities but does not provide an identity-specific mapping for these source records; grouping would be unsafe.
